q: I feel like everyone commenting here is giving me the mother energy I’m craving. ❤️❤️
cx: London, six months pregnant, visiting her mother abroad in 44-degree heat.

q: I’ve always felt my mum is not aware of how I feel, she is the most cutest woman but I feel more like her mother than her daughter.
cx: Looking after her widowed mother while pregnant.

q: she then started pushing the narrative that I was terrified of birth and it was ruining my mental health 👁️👄👁️ so I explained to her, I’m not scared about giving birth, it’s just not something I want to go vaginally.
cx: Her midwife's response when she asked for a planned surgical birth.

q: “I’m not worrying about the birth. I’m mostly worrying about when the child is out- like organising childcare is my biggest concern”.
cx: What she told her midwife really worries her.

q: I’ve now been referred to mental health services, counselling and some course to help with fear around birth… I wasn’t having any major upsets around birth but now I am!
cx: The outcome of that appointment.

q: it’ll be less stressful for my partner (since he almost faints when I have my blood taken. I don’t want him to have to endure a vaginal birth too)
cx: One of her reasons.

q: My MIL seems to think she’ll have unfettered access to our child, including stating to us that she’ll be “buying her own stroller, pack and play, clothes” for her house (not asking us, TELLING us that). She jokingly asked if she could pay to be in the delivery room.
cx: 34 weeks, first grandchild on his side.

q: My husband feels similarly and has told them we will let them know if we need help but to not plan on just being over all the time.
cx: Her husband's line with his family.

q: The aunt had called in a panic saying she ordered us a $700 recliner and she realized she should’ve asked us if we needed it first, but it’s being delivered on x date. We already have a recliner
cx: After the shower, in a two-bedroom apartment.

q: I feel like our needs and wants are being completely overlooked in favor of whatever people just feel like buying us, whether it’s helpful or not.
cx: Gifts that ignore the registry.

q: He was told by my MIL that he’s unappreciative.
cx: After her husband turned down a roadside bookcase.

q: When I finally returned again, I got a call from my boss's boss's boss firing me for being "unproductive". You're telling me I wasn't a "high performer" whilst I was on company-approved mat leave? Crazy.
cx: Tech worker, six weeks into her second pregnancy, recalling her first leave in 2023.

q: But I'm still so scared that I'll be fired again for taking maternity leave. That someone may come in and, I don't know, do ~~AI~~ stuff to "replace" me
cx: Despite a supportive boss and 16 weeks' leave.

q: I won't need to take leave until February, I won't even tell anyone at work until August at the earliest, but I am absolutely *terrified*.
cx: Her timeline for telling work.

q: I have a very supportive group of friends and family, but none that really "get it". Most of my friends either have no kids or don't have careers.
cx: Why she posted.

q: Maternity leave at this company is also 16 weeks, so 4 months. So generous and yet I'm so scared to take it again. But I know what that newborn phase is like and I know that I want/need to take it.
cx: Second time, she knows what the leave is for.

q: The next 2-3 weeks I have basically be every day appointments with Doctors, Hospitals, Midwife, Doula, Acupuncture and what else. I don’t have even 2 following days per week to focus on myself and baby
cx: 34 weeks, overwhelmed by the schedule.

q: When she left I saw that she made pictures of the complete nursery, even inside the wardrobe plus the living room where the stroller is. I ordered her to delete these photos.
cx: Her mother came to help clean before the birth.

q: She wants to come help me postpartum recover, I’m afraid she will make pictures and videos of the baby. Therefore I will ask her to leave her phone with me or go home.
cx: Her rule for her mother's postpartum stay.

q: Doula will be my birth partner and we have still 2 appointments for hypnotherapy and birth plan together. Yes, the acupuncturist I will try to get rid of, for no she’s just adding stress and the time there is not as relaxing as I hoped.
cx: What she is paying for in the last weeks.

q: I will be alone after giving birth so this is why I thought my mother will be a good help, especially since she worked for 30 years in the maternity ward.
cx: Why her mother is coming.

q: Every single day for the past week my cousin has texted me “ no baby yet?” Like holy shit I’m losing my mind. Not even a “ how are you doing?”
cx: Overdue with her first.

q: as if everyone wants an update every day while they never checked in on me during MY ACTUAL PREGNANCY.
cx: The texts after the due date.

q: I was one day past due and she’s texting me asking if I’m going to get induced & if I’m going to breastfeed. Like we aren’t even close like that.
cx: A cousin's questions a day past the due date.
